project_name: Gestão de Ordens de Serviço (OS) - Frota de Ônibus Escolares
app_type: dashboard / saas_app (sistema interno de gestão de frota)
design_system_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2 (Performance & Tactical Precision) + ARCHETYPE 4 (Swiss & High Contrast)

design_probabilistic_options.name: Tactical School Amber & Deep Slate Navy (Selected Winner)
design_probabilistic_options.description: High-contrast industrial aesthetic combining vibrant School Bus Yellow/Amber (#F59E0B / #D97706) with ultra-clean Deep Slate Navy (#0F172A) and stark gray backgrounds. Heavy emphasis on mobile touch targets (48px+), monospace license plate badges, and crisp official document styling for print/PDF.

design_probabilistic_options.name: Swiss Industrial High-Density Monochrome
design_probabilistic_options.description: Minimalist 1px grid layout with stark signal yellow accents for critical statuses and dense data tables for supervisory fleet control.

design_probabilistic_options.name: Dark Tactical Command Dashboard
design_probabilistic_options.description: OLED dark mode UI built for low-light morning depot operations with glowing status pills and high contrast night legibility.

design_probabilistic_options.name: Neumorphic Depot Touchpanel
design_probabilistic_options.description: Soft tactile rounded components with physical button cues suitable for rugged mobile devices.

design_probabilistic_options.name: Retro Workshop Paper & Blueprint Hybrid
design_probabilistic_options.description: Blueprint grid aesthetic with digital paper texture overlays mimicking traditional clipboard OS sheets.

primary.usage: Primary headers, main action containers, active tabs, dark surface cards

brand_amber.usage: Primary CTA buttons ('Criar Nova Solicitação'), school bus brand accents, focus rings

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for buttons and form fields on mobile views
spacing_and_layout.card_padding: p-5 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 with 1px solid border (#E2E8F0)

grid_modes.driver_dashboard: Single column quick-card stack on mobile (space-y-4), 2-column on tablet
grid_modes.supervisor_dashboard: Bento dashboard metric summary top row (4 cols), sticky filter bar, full responsive data table with horizontal scroll fallback
grid_modes.pdf_print_sheet: Strict A4 physical layout dimensions (max-w-[800px] mx-auto, 24px internal print padding, black/white high-contrast ink safe styling)

screen_login.role_toggle_or_auto_detect: Identifica se é Motorista ou Supervisor/Admin
screen_login.decorations: Background ambient image of yellow school bus with dark overlay scrim

screen_painel_motorista.hero_action: Grand button 'Criar Nova Solicitação' with Amber accent and plus icon
screen_painel_motorista.summary_bar: Quick count badges (Suas OSs, Em Manutenção, Concluídas)
screen_painel_motorista.list_item: Mobile-optimized card showing Plate (badge), Date/Time, OS Number (e.g. OS-2026-004), Problem Summary excerpt, Status Pill

interactive_fields: Seleção do Veículo (Dropdown de Ônibus cadastrados com opção de entrada Manual)
Grau de Urgência (Baixa, Média, Alta, Crítica)

admin_features: Gestão de Veículos (Cadastrar Placa, Modelo, Ano, Capacidade)

screen_oficial_pdf_print.title: ORDEM DE SERVIÇO DE MANUTENÇÃO - VEÍCULOS ESCOLARES
sections: Dados do Veículo (Placa, Modelo, KM Atual, Prefixo)
Campos para Assinatura Física (Assinatura do Motorista + Assinatura do Mecânico/Supervisor)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='login-matricula-input', data-testid='create-os-button', data-testid='os-status-badge', data-testid='print-os-pdf-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA Compliant, text over badges must use high contrast dark ink on light tinted backgrounds
testing_and_accessibility.toast_notifications: Use sonner for success/error feedback on status changes and OS submissions

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interaction components have explicitly specified data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use generic blue or default raw unstyled Tailwind forms; customize inputs with crisp borders, focus rings (amber/navy), and high contrast readable text.
Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the repository.

Ensure the PDF print component uses clean `@media print` CSS rules so that printing or downloading hides navigation overlays, headers, and buttons, rendering only the clean official OS form with signature blocks.
Support full Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) terminology throughout the application.
